svg.title: From nutrient enrichment to oxygen stress
svg.desc: Original conditional six-stage pathway linking excess nutrients, algal growth, shading and dead biomass, aerobic decomposition, oxygen demand and harm to sensitive aquatic organisms. Daytime photosynthesis can also supply oxygen.

g.text: A simplified pathway, with conditions at every step
Transport from land can include leaching and runoff
2 · Growth increases where nutrients were limiting
A dense algal population can develop
3 · Shading and biomass turnover add dead material
Submerged plants may receive less light
Aeration, photosynthesis and mixing affect the balance
6 · Low oxygen stresses sensitive aquatic organisms
Responses vary by species and exposure
Algae can add oxygen in daylight; respiration continues at night.
Nutrients are the input, not a direct explanation of oxygen loss.
